annotations.limits: ai_ready_mw is a market-level PROXY from disclosed installed capacity — no per-rack power density or cooling type is ingested, because no public source publishes it. Directional, not a spec claim · deployable_mw is an estimate from market depth, not a measured interconnect result

description: Use this when the user asks where AI compute capacity could land: ranks data center markets by where 100MW of AI training capacity can land in the next 30/60/90 days. Returns top markets with facility_count, operator_count, deployable_mw estimate (megawatts), hyperscale_ready flag, rack power density and cooling-type signals where facility data carries them, and composite score (depth + diversity + power). Refreshed Fridays 14:00 UTC. Use for AI capex planning, GPU cluster siting, hyperscaler deal forecasting. For grid power availability use DCPI (rank_markets ai_ready). Do NOT use for a general best-markets ranking (use rank_markets) or forward grid-emergence (use grid_transition_radar).

limit.description: Number of top markets to return (default 20)
